before-completing-pandemonium.npc: Jakob! A master of the surf, my friend. A true guru!
A surfer at heart. That's where I got my start, but you can't take a cargo crate on a board, so being a sailor pays the bills!

before-completing-pandemonium.player: Well, at least sailing still lets you enjoy the sea when you're not surfing.

before-completing-pandemonium.npc: Very true! Until next time, friend.

before-level-40-sailing.npc: Jakob! A master of the surf, my friend. A true guru!
A surfer at heart. That's where I got my start, but you can't take a cargo crate on a board, so being a sailor pays the bills!

before-level-40-sailing.player: Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself. Maybe you'd be interested in joining me once I'm ready for that sort of thing?

before-level-40-sailing.npc: Sounds swell! You just let me know once you are.

before-level-40-sailing.text: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.

before-level-40-sailing-again.npc: Very well, thank you. Still sailing, and surfing, of course!

options.text: If you're a sailor, would you be interested in joining my crew?

steps.text: If the player's Sailing level is under 95:

steps.player: If you're a sailor, would you be interested in joining my crew?

steps.npc: Sorry, but I don't think you've got what it takes to surf, friend.

steps.text: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 95 Sailing.
If the player's Sailing level is at least 95:

steps.player: If you're a sailor, would you be interested in joining my crew?

steps.npc: Yeah, I think we can make a surfer out of you for sure!

steps.text: Player has space in their crew:
You recruit Sailor Jakob as a crew member. He heads off in search of your boat.
You recruit Sailor Jakob as a crew member. He departs for the Pandemonium.

steps.player: Well, good luck with it all.

steps.npc: And you! Until next time, friend.

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: Hello there. How are you enjoying being part of the crew?

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: I'm so relaxed! Would like a touch more surfing on my rota though.

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: I'll see what I can do.
